description: Original fictional wuxia, xianxia and cultivation content: sects, martial techniques, realms, treasures, jianghu nicknames, mountains, secret realms and pinyin-style names with English glosses. Not a reconstruction of any real tradition or published setting.

provenance.title: Synthetic wuxia / xianxia corpus
provenance.creator: LexiconLang contributors
provenance.attribution: All strings in this pack are original synthetic fiction authored for LexiconLang. Pinyin-style spellings are invented aesthetics, not transcriptions of living people's names. No trademarks, real sects or setting-specific IP are reproduced.

grammars.description: Martial arts techniques, including the Nine Heavens Thunder family.
Cultivation realms on an original ladder of invented stages.
Treasures, pills and spirit artifacts (fictional items only).
Jianghu nicknames used by wanderers and martial artists.
Sacred mountains and famous peaks (fictional geography).
Secret realms, hidden valleys and trial grounds.
Alchemical pills and elixirs from an invented pharmacopoeia.

tables.description: 2d6 ascension trial oracle for a fictional cultivation ladder (not a game-balance rule).

result.text: The sky stays clear; the trial passes without incident.
A cold wind turns the cultivator's robe inside out.
Red thunder splits the peak; the third strike is the true one.
An old regret speaks in a familiar voice. It knows your name.
A pillar of cloud descends; the mountain holds its breath.
Two trials arrive together. Even the master steps back.

tables.description: Weighted roadside encounter oracle for jianghu wanderers.

result.text: A laughing beggar offers a riddle and refuses payment.
A temple bell rings at dusk with no one near the rope.
A white crane lands on the road and will not move aside.
Sword-light flashes above the ridge; no thunder follows.
A paper lantern drifts upstream against the current.
A merchant sells an empty gourd and calls it a treasure.
A child's song names a name no living elder recognizes.
A sword master asks directions to a village that burned years ago.

generators.description: Portable subset: a pinyin-style given name with a literal gloss. The TS facade also picks a naming style and prefixes a surname.
Portable subset: a pinyin-style settlement name with a literal gloss. The TS facade may pick either naming style.
